Q: Cannot assign void to an implicitly-typed variable in Visual Studio 2026 A:

I was able to solve the issue by changing the line to

var provValue = Enumerable.Reverse(registryValue.Split(','));

In my case, the LangVersion was set to the value latest.

When using C# 14 or newer and targeting a .NET older than net10.0 or .NET Framework with System.Memory reference, there is a breaking change with Enumerable.Reverse and arrays.

This only impacts customers using C# 14 and targeting .NET earlier than net10.0, which is an unsupported configuration.

int[] x = new[] { 1, 2, 3 };
var y = x.Reverse(); // previously Enumerable.Reverse, now MemoryExtensions.Reverse

On net10.0, there is Enumerable.Reverse(this T[]) which takes precedence and hence the break is avoided. Otherwise, MemoryExtensions.Reverse(this Span<T>) is resolved which has different semantics than Enumerable.Reverse(this IEnumerable<T>) (which used to be resolved in C# 13 and lower). Specifically, the Span extension does the reversal in place and returns void. As a workaround, one can define their own Enumerable.Reverse(this T[]) or use Enumerable.Reverse explicitly:

int[] x = new[] { 1, 2, 3 };
var y = Enumerable.Reverse(x); // instead of 'x.Reverse();'

Referecne: https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/blob/main/docs/compilers/CSharp/Compiler%20Breaking%20Changes%20-%20DotNet%2010.md#enumerablereverse

I would also suggest to have a strict version of language is that we shouldn’t face this issue in such cases.

Q: PdfAcroForm doesn't set values with SetValue A:

The fields are all set to "protected" as Read Only. Thus they have 2 problems such that as Read-only they default the appearance to the odd derived Current Appearance (/CA) state.

If you first unlock the fields they will behave as normal, (they should turn pale blue).
Here is the unlocked file, you can simply use any viewer or browser to fill the fields as they should have been set thus no need to program! https://fileport.io/1vq1672XufvG

Q: How can I stop EditText from gaining focus when an activity starts in Android? A:

Add android:windowSoftInputMode="stateAlwaysHidden" in the activity tag of the Manifest.xml file.

Q: Every activity can use "android.intent.action.MAIN"? A:

its wrong 

    <action android:name="ACTIVITYNAME FOR INTENT" />


    <category android:name=""/> // android.intent.action.DEFAULT or android.intent.action.MAIN

android.intent.action.MAIN is given to the activity wich is going to launch at first and

android.intent.action.OTHER to the rest of the activities getting called by other activities

Your application will refer to the manifest to fetch the activity for first launch , havin MAIN in it

Q: MVC Navigate to different controller view A:

Try this:

RedirectToAction("Edit", "Profile", new {id = 1, otherParam = "foo"});

This won't render view of another controller - but it will navigate to action of another controller (which is supposed to render view you are looking for).
